fields.label: Title
fields.value: Wicks wins first prize for poster design

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Courtlandt Gross, left, President of Vega Aircraft, presents Ren Wicks with a war bond, the first prize in the professional class poster design, at the Advertising Club meeting held at the Biltmore Hotel. Wicks is shown holding the poster which won him the award. Poster reads, "It's your fight, Buy more war bonds and stamps."  Photo dated: August 25, 1942.
